question: Who among the following was the first Indian to be recruited in Indian Civil Service in British India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Satyendranath Tagore.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Satyendranath Tagore** was the first Indian to be selected for the Indian Civil Services (ICS) in **1862** and joined service in **1864**.
 
• He was the elder brother of **Rabindranath Tagore.**
 
• The Indian Civil Service originated in the **Covenanted Civil Service (CCS)** and was later formalized under British rule. The **Indian Civil Service Act of 1861** allowed Indians limited participation in the service.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rabindranath Tagore-**

 
 
• Rabindranath Tagore is also known as **Kobiguru, Biswakobi, the Bard of Bengal.**
 
• He was a **Bengali poet, philosopher, composer, writer, and painter.**
 
• He was the **first Indian** to win the **Nobel Prize in Literature** for his poetry collection "**Gitanjali**" in **1913**.
 
• He wrote the lyrics of the **National anthems of India and Bangladesh**:
 
 
• "**Jana Gana Mana**" was adopted as India's **national anthem**.
 
• "**Amar Sonar Bangla**" – adopted as the **National Anthem of Bangladesh**.
 
 
 
• **Shantiniketan**, later known as **Visva Bharati University**, was founded by Rabindranath Tagore.
 
 
 
• **Surendra Nath Banerjee-**
 
 
• Surendra Nath Banerjee was among the earliest **political leaders** during British rule.
 
• He founded the **Indian National Association**, a Nationalist organization that later merged with the INC.
 
• He presided over the **1895 session** of the Indian National Congress but not in 1902.
 
• He was the **second Indian** to qualify for the **Indian Civil Service Examination in 1869** but was later dismissed due to alleged age misrepresentation.
 
 
 
• **Rahimtulla M Sayani-**
 
 
• Rahimtulla M Sayani was the **second Muslim to serve as the President of INC** after Badruddin Tyabji.
 
• **Vande Mataram** was sung for the first time before a gathering at the **12th annual Congress session of the INC** held in **Calcutta in 1896**. This Congress session was presided over by **Rahimtulla M. Sayani.**
